data.one_liner: A Flutter package for trimming, cropping, rotating, and exporting videos with a customizable UI.
data.what_it_does: Provides a controller‑based API to load a video file, adjust trim and crop regions, rotate the clip, and select cover frames. It generates FFmpeg command strings for you to run the actual export yourself.
use_when: You need on‑device video editing (trim, crop, rotate) with a flexible UI
You want full control over the export command (FFmpeg)
Your app targets Android and iOS
avoid_when: You require web or desktop video editing support (currently mobile only)
You need automatic export handling without writing your own FFmpeg integration
strengths: Highly customizable UI and command generation
Supports both video and cover thumbnail selection
No native FFmpeg dependency in the package itself
weaknesses: Export must be handled manually with another FFmpeg library
Limited to mobile platforms for now
data.setup_notes: Add video_editor to pubspec, ensure video_thumbnail and video_player are included, and integrate an FFmpeg runner (e.g., ffmpeg_kit_flutter) for export; requires Android/iOS permissions for file access.
